name: v4.76.0
body:
## What's Changed

### Features
* feat(sessions): Add chronological session list view by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19650
* feat(telemetry): report AI gateway key count from self-hosted instances by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19680
* feat(topics): add Topics summaries, assignments and rules to the public API, MCP and in-app agent by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19308
* feat(audit-logs): record read-access events for tRPC trace, session and score reads by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19625
* feat(sessions): Add session tab in trace peek view by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19301
* feat(web): searchable org, project and switcher by @aasimmk in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/14211
* feat(analytics): record how and where each Cloud sign-up came from by @AbdallahAHO in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19710
* feat(auth): give sign-up email codes 10 minutes and a clear expired step by @AbdallahAHO in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19711
* feat(analytics): record the email sign-up's steps and send its webhook on verify by @AbdallahAHO in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19712
* feat(prompts): record resolved prompt length and dependency count by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19754
* perf(topics): serve the Topics page from counts and a paged trace list by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19672
* feat(skills): add tracing quick start to usage by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19706
* perf(prompts): memoize dependency fetches during prompt resolution by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19755
* perf(ingestion): process scores without queue delay by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19771
* perf(evals): drop the trace prefilter from evaluator cost queries by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19772
* feat(trace-batching): record and dispatch trace rule selections through per-trace Redis maps by @marliessophie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19554
* feat(ai-gateway): ship the gateway in the self-hosted docker compose by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19769
* perf(evals): skip S3 LIST when ingesting eval scores by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19592
* feat(audit-logs): record exports and downloads as access events by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19757
* feat(pagerduty): send monitor alerts as custom details and match Slack links by @marksalpeter in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19782
* feat(trace-dispatch): carry recorded rule IDs and failure count in dispatched traces by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19796

### Fixes
* fix(blob-export): read events_full when the metadata field group is selected by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19669
* fix(ui): make Label block-level so stacked field spacing applies by @dergeraetbot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18617
* fix(web): navigate on row click in the Users and Sessions tables by @dergeraetbot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18972
* fix(clickhouse): keep hyphenated routes in the query outcome metric by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19624
* fix(ai-gateway): stop clipping the gateway keys search focus ring by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19682
* fix(web): add ph-no-capture to KeyValueFilterBuilder by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19683
* fix(topics): disregard app root by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19203
* fix(web): stop sending LLM connection names to PostHog by @nmtrang29 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19697
* fix(web): reject manual time edits that invert a date range by @dakjdakd in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18049
* fix: clear the command menu search on close by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19381
* fix(annotation-queues): save pending score comment on Mark Completed by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19696
* fix(topics): allow trigger as member by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19715
* fix(web): always label the prompts sidebar group Context Management by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19714
* fix(web): sentence-case sidebar navigation labels by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19589
* fix(sidebar): remove extra top gap above demo project label by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19734
* revert: cap resolved prompt size during dependency resolution (#19631) by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19742
* fix(worker): keep PostHog exports fresh across UTC midnight by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19718
* fix(api): reject unfinished empty observation pages by @sumerman in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19756
* fix(mcp): Track MCP observation query characteristics by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19733
* fix(ui): make the row-resize cursor wait for a resting pointer by @dergeraetbot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18973
* fix(ai-gateway): list only gateway keys in the analytics key filter by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19764
* fix(evals): explain a missing decision-model endpoint instead of a bare Not Found by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19726
* fix(web): refresh comments panel when switching traces by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19693
* fix(blob-export): stop gzip exports from stalling when the uploader reads late by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19717
* fix(sessions): Wrongly displayed tool in filtered session view by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19699
* fix(web): Protect session sidebar customer data from capture by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19775
* fix(ai-gateway): disable Nagle on accepted client connections by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19789
* fix(web): keep overlay layer nodes inside document.body by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19750
* fix(worker): auto-disable PostHog export on rejected API key (401) by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19783
* fix(worker): auto-disable Mixpanel export on customer faults by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19784
* fix(shared): comment content "=" filter matches exact content by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19720
* fix(web): rename the Attributes tab and sections to Metadata by @nmtrang29 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19770
* fix(web): Unify trace, session and observation headers by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19779
* fix(annotation-queues): send the completion comment after the score's value save by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19725
* fix(topics): show the shared spinner and start all Topics requests at once by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19193
* fix(shared): cap free-form score fields in analytics exports by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19719

### Chores
* test(ai-gateway): cover cross-organization and missing invoke scope on analytics queries by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19678
* fix(ci): give the weekly CI runtime analyst enough turns to finish by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19679
* fix(web): flush Radix focus-scope timers before jsdom teardown in client tests by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19677
* chore(topics): remove the unused trace backfill operator script by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19681
* test(web): drop commented-out clickhouse bad escape ingestion test by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19656
* refactor(web): remove nested ternary disable in JSON tree builder by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19674
* chore(web): Disable nextjs image lint rule by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19690
* chore(pricing): add missing Ultrafast tiers to gpt-6.1-sol by @langfuse-bot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19662
* refactor(web): remove eslint-disable from ComposerSurface by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19691
* chore: Change release reminder cadence by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19701
* docs(review): push back on low-value tests in Claude review by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19695
* chore(deps): migrate web and worker to the current Langfuse SDK by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19698
* chore(web): Disable Storybook build sourcemaps by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19707
* chore(internal): clickhouse/langfuse users are internal by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19164
* docs(agents): write fewer, better tests by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19703
* ci: Fix Vercel storybook and api spec deployments by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19702
* chore(deps): bump pnpm to 12.16.1 by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19730
* docs: sync READMEs with current website and docs by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19739
* docs: merge Python and JS dependents in README by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19743
* fix(ci): don't check licenses for optional pkgs by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19745
* fix(storybook): dropdown by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19761
* docs(agents): follow AGENTS.md before adding backend tests by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19729
* docs: Improve REVIEW.md regarding CSS selectors by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19762
* refactor(web): remove eslint-disable from MonitorAutomationsPanel by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19749
* refactor(web): remove no-use-before-define disable in multi-tenant SSO utils by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19751
* refactor(web): Remove icon-* tailwind classes by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19765
* refactor(web): remove eslint-disable from ControlledHoverCard stories by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19752
* docs(agents): restructure state instead of layering effects by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19716
* test(worker): drop duplicate events-table export tests by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19694
* test(web): drop duplicate sessionId metrics filter by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19774
* chore(shared): add client-safe filter predicate with FilterState codec by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19276
* refactor(web): Extract QueryInput and QueryTokens design-system by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19780
* test(web): drop buildFilterSystemPrompt.length arity check by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19776
* docs(agents): resolve bot review threads after fixing them by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19773

## New Contributors
* @aasimmk made their first contribution in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/14211

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/compare/v4.75.0...v4.76.0
